title: Missing Soldier
description: Corporal Wex Bramwell and Private Toma Idle rode the south road six days ago and never came back. Their horses did, saddles empty, two mornings later. The garrison is short-handed and the captain cannot spare a squad to go looking without leaving the wall thin, so he is paying a stranger to find out how many of his men are still breathing.

objectives.description: Track the missing patrol to the southern bandit camp

notes: Rescue kind 2 of 4: too late for part of it. Two men rode out, one is already dead by the time the player arrives (revealed in part 2, not part 1). Giver motive: the captain is short-handed and cannot pull a squad off the wall to look himself. Consequence of refusal: the garrison writes off both men as deserters and stops patrolling that stretch of road.
